نستأني (form X)
# نَسْتَأْنِي (nastaʔnī) /nas.taʔ.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# نَسْتَأْنِيَ (nastaʔniya) /nas.taʔ.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
